Nina R: Quick sync  - Steering wants a short QBR appendix showing partner tier moves + an MDF reprovision plan. Can we run a 3-hour blitz today?
Caleb J: I can. Are we doing a full-tier reset or just temporary bump for SI partners with active marketplace listings?
Zara K: Temporary bump + credit experimentation. Finance only greenlit reassignments if we show conservative conversion assumptions.
Theo M: Proposal: create 3 credit buckets (kickstart $3k, accelerate $12k, scale $30k) for SIs; a separate microgrant bucket ($1k-$4k) for marketplace co-marketing. Pilot = $60k total.
Nina R: Love the bands. Add rule: credits expire 45 days, must register a joint playbook and one enablement session before activation.
Caleb J: I'll add the rule. Also suggest a pass/fail 'integration readiness' flag (api listed + billing verified). Keeps scoring objective.
Zara K: For scorecard recalibration, can we tilt 15 pts toward '90d pipeline influence' and reduce 'social/promotional reach' by 10? We need measurable levers.
Theo M: Agree. And add a short enablement rubric: 0 = none, 1 = playbook only, 2 = playbook + 1 enablement, 3 = playbook + enablement + proof point (closed opp).
FinanceBot: MDF headroom: $120,000. Reallocating $60k leaves $60k for existing contractual commitments. Attach conservative conversion: 5% conversion within 90d for enablement credits.
Caleb J: If 5% conversion holds, $60k in credits roughly maps to ~$400k ACV (using avg deal size assumptions). I'll put the math in the sheet.
Nina R: Action items: (1) Caleb -> populate partner candidate list + integration readiness (2) Zara -> update scorecard weights + add enablement rubric (3) Theo -> map credit bands to partner maturity + ask sizes (4) FinanceBot -> lock remaining contractual constraints. Due EOD.
Zara K: One edge case: large SI with multi-region commitments has contractual co-marketing earmarked Q3. We should exclude those funds. Will mark them in the sheet.
Caleb J: Done. Dropped CSV link: https://drive.redwood/partnerships/credit-pilot-candidates.csv. Marked 'contract_block' column.
Theo M: I'll draft a 2-slide appendix: slide 1 = scorecard changes + rubric, slide 2 = pilot plan + ROI assumptions + action list.
FinanceBot: Reminder: Conversions must be stress-tested at 3% and 8% sensitivity for exec view.
Nina R: Good call. Partnerships-bot: set check-in 14:45 PT for review.
partnerships-bot: Reminder set: 'Credit bucket pilot review' added to calendar for 2026-07-21 14:45 PT (organizer: Nina R).
Caleb J: Can someone sanity-check the avg deal size I'm using ($75k ACV)? Might be too high for micro SIs.
Zara K: Use $45k median for micro, $120k for strategic SIs. I'll annotate the sheet.
Nina R: Thanks team. If we can finalize numbers by 17:30 I'll circulate the appendix to Steering. :thumbsup:
